newsitem.title: USA: Meredith Q2 paced by publishing business.
newsitem.headline: Meredith Q2 paced by publishing business.

text.p: Meredith Corp, reporting improved operating earnings for the December 31 second quarter, said operating profit in publishing rose 30 percent in the period.

It cited strong performance by its Better Homes & Gardens, Country Home and Midwest Living magazines as well as Ladies' Home Journal. Operating profit in the company's book publishing sector declined due to a lower rate of introduction of new titles.
Broadcasting operating profit advanced 14 percent. Meredith president William Kerr said in a statement, "All of our stations achieved increased operating profits for the second quarter."
Quarterly operating earnings rose to $0.65 a share from $0.57 in the same year-ago period.

Revenues were $209.8 million compared with $216.1 million. The decrease primarily reflected the prior-year sale of the company's book clubs and the effect of a rate base reduction at Ladies' Home Journal magazine. Changing the number of issues published by Country America from 10 to six annually and closing home garden and Weekend Woodworking magazines also contributed.
Excluding these changes, revenues increased about seven percent quarter-over-quarter, the media company said.
